record.fact_text: The Key Employee Initiative carries a first-time application fee of EUR 600, with renewals charged at EUR 150 per year for the duration of the permit (up to three years).
record.evidence_quote: First-time applications - €600 Renewal applications €150 per year for the duration of the permit

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the fast-track costs the same flat permit fee as any permit. Actually the KEI has its own schedule: EUR 600 first-time and EUR 150 per renewal year. Action: budget EUR 600 up front plus EUR 150 per year for renewals under KEI.
